lead.headline: You traded for Daniels and Likely — and Week 7 still has no quarterback
lead.deck: Barkley and Tate went to Kings of the North. Daniels starts Monday; Washington and Jacksonville share the Week 7 bye.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Washington and Jacksonville are both off in Week 7, so the trade that made Jayden Daniels your quarterback leaves you with none that week: Daniels and Trevor Lawrence share the bye, and Tuesday's job is a free-agent quarterback for Lawrence. Rashee Rice is out again and Josh Jacobs cannot play until Week 7. The rest is good news: you sent Saquon Barkley, ruled out with his hamstring, and Carnell Tate to Kings of the North for Daniels and Isaiah Likely, and the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.6 against Los Cachanillas' 85.9 — they still start the ruled-out Jalen Hurts.
